x: Third Anglo-Mysore War (1790-92 A.D.) ended with the Treaty of Srirangapatna (1792 A.D.). The treaty of Seringapatam (Srirangapatna) was signed in March 1792 A.D. between Tipu Sultan of Mysore and Lord Cornwallis on behalf of British East India Company. The agreement also included representative of the Nizam of Hyderabad and Maratha Empire, requiring Tipu to Cede half of his Kingdom. According to the treaty, Half of the territories of Tipu were snatched away from him and divided among Marathas, British, and Nizam.
